description: PTA data sets for the NG15 GWB reproduction. Raw files live in data/raw/ (git-ignored); regenerate with `uv run python scripts/fetch_data.py`.

not_available.ng15_gwb_official_chain_release: No dedicated Zenodo/NANOGrav-webpage release of the full GWB-paper chains exists (checked nanograv.org/science/data and Zenodo search, 2026-10-06). The GWB chains used for the paper figures are distributed via Google Drive links in nanograv/15yr_stochastic_analysis/data_release (fetched above as ng15_gwb_fig*).
not_available.ppta_dr3_profiles: PPTA DR3 profile / UWL data products (~1.4 TB per collection) deliberately not fetched; only toas_and_parameters/.
not_available.ppta_dr3_part2: CSIRO collection 59381 (part 2 of 2) lists the same toas_and_parameters/ files as part 1; not fetched separately.

ng15_v2.1.0.description: NANOGrav 15-yr data set, latest version (v2.1.0) of concept record 7967584: narrowband+wideband par/tim, clock files, noise-modelling MCMC chains (added in v2), NoRedNoise/predictive par files, correlation matrices, post-fit residuals.
ng15_v2.1.0.title: The NANOGrav 15-Year Data Set

ng15_v1.0.1.description: NANOGrav 15-yr data set v1.0.1 (the June-2023 release contemporaneous with the GWB paper; v1.0.1 only fixes the tarball directory structure of v1.0.0). Kept to verify that the narrowband par/tim used for the GWB analysis are unchanged in later versions.
ng15_v1.0.1.title: The NANOGrav 15-Year Data Set

ng15_tutorial_repo.description: nanograv/15yr_stochastic_analysis (official companion repo of arXiv:2306.16213): 15yr_wn_dict.json (fixed white-noise dictionary EFAC/EQUAD/ECORR), 15yr_emp_distr.json (intrinsic-RN empirical distributions), 67 Enterprise-derived pulsar feather files (v1p1_de440_pint_bipm2019-*.feather), presampled la_forge cores (CURN/HD 14f varied-gamma, HD 30f free spectrum, spline ORF, TI), optimal-statistic results. The README warns the tutorial data are 'reduced' and may not reproduce the paper exactly.
ng15_tutorial_repo.note: GitHub archive tarballs are not guaranteed byte-stable; the commit sha is the authoritative identifier.

discovery_repo.description: nanograv/discovery source + data/: 67 NG15 feather files (v1p1_de440_pint_bipm2019-*), NG15yr-m2a-chain.feather (CURN) and NG15yr-m3a-chain.feather (HD) reference chains, EPTA DR2 feathers. Oracle/reference only.
discovery_repo.note: GitHub archive tarballs are not guaranteed byte-stable; the commit sha is the authoritative identifier.

ng15_cw_analysis.description: NG15 continuous-wave analysis release (arXiv:2306.16222): contains v1p1_all_dict.json (white-noise + intrinsic red-noise values for every pulsar), enterprise Pulsar pickles (jar/), pulsar distances. We need it for the noise dictionary.
ng15_cw_analysis.title: Continuous Wave Analysis of the NANOGrav 15-Year Dataset

ng15_sensitivity_curves.description: Noise spectra + GWB sensitivity curves for NG15 (detector-characterization paper, arXiv:2306.16218).
ng15_sensitivity_curves.title: Noise Spectra and Stochastic Background Sensitivity Curve for the NG15-year Dataset

ng15_kde_freespec_v1.description: Ceffyl KDE representations of the NG15 GWB free spectra, v1.0.0.
ng15_kde_freespec_v1.title: KDE Representations of the Gravitational Wave Background Free Spectra Present in the NANOGrav 15-Year Dataset

ng15_kde_freespec_v2.description: Ceffyl KDE representations of the NG15 GWB free spectra, v2.0.0 (30f CURN / 30f HD free spectra).
ng15_kde_freespec_v2.title: KDE Representations of the Gravitational Wave Background Free Spectra Present in the NANOGrav 15-Year Dataset

ng15_gwb_fig1_data.description: Data behind Fig. 1 of arXiv:2306.16213 (linked from 15yr_stochastic_analysis/data_release/figure_1). Google Drive, no checksum published.

ng15_gwb_fig7_os.description: Data behind Fig. 7 (optimal statistic / Legendre; data_release/figure_7). 2.7 GB.

ng15_newphysics_chains.description: MCMC chains of the NG15 new-physics paper (arXiv:2306.16219), 22.4 GB single file. Not the baseline GWB analysis; optional.

epta_dr2_zenodo.description: EPTA DR2 paper I data set (DR2full/DR2new, 25 MSPs, par/tim), Zenodo concept 8164424.
epta_dr2_zenodo.title: The second data release from the European Pulsar Timing Array I. The dataset and timing analysis

epta_dr2_noise_models.description: EPTA DR2 paper II: customised noise models (posterior distributions, whitened residuals).
epta_dr2_noise_models.title: The second data release from the European Pulsar Timing Array II. Customised pulsar noise models for spatially correlated gravitational waves

epta_dr2_gwb_chains.description: EPTA DR2 paper III: GWB search chains (arXiv:2306.16214).
epta_dr2_gwb_chains.title: The second data release from the European Pulsar Timing Array III. Search for gravitational wave signals

ppta_dr3_timing.description: PPTA DR3 (doi:10.25919/j4xr-wp05, CSIRO DAP collection 59374 v2, part 1 of 2): only ppta_dr3/toas_and_parameters/ (par, tim, noise files, clock) and READMEs. The ~1.4 TB of profile/UWL data products are not fetched. DAP publishes no checksums.

inpta_dr2.description: InPTA DR2 (27 MSPs, uGMRT) official GitHub release repository.
inpta_dr2.note: GitHub archive tarballs are not guaranteed byte-stable; the commit sha is the authoritative identifier.

inpta_dr2_noise.note: GitHub archive tarballs are not guaranteed byte-stable; the commit sha is the authoritative identifier.
